entities.name: Theodotus of Aetolia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Theodotus was an Aetolian mercenary commander, who at the accession of the Seleucid monarch, Antiochus III the Great, was in Ptolemaic service and held the command of the important province of Coele-Syria for Ptolemy Philopator, king of Egypt.
